name: Brevo
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an integrated marketing and customer relationship platform that combines email, SMS, WhatsApp, chat, and a built-in CRM so businesses can run coordinated campaigns across channels from one place.
best_for: Positioned for businesses of various sizes that want to manage customer interactions and run coordinated marketing campaigns across integrated channels without stitching together separate tools.
features: Email marketing campaign creation and sending
Built-in CRM for managing customer relationships
Live chat for on-site customer engagement

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a wide template library and app ecosystem

alternatives.name: Constant Contact
alternatives.description: A digital and email marketing platform for small businesses, with email, SMS, landing pages, and automation.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting a simple, all-in-one campaign tool

alternatives.name: GetResponse
alternatives.description: An all-in-one marketing platform combining email, automation, landing pages, and webinars.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that also need webinars and AI-assisted landing pages
